assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Six four-point configurations, short distances solid and long distances dashed red, each with its ratio: a square (square root of 2), four vertices of a regular pentagon ((1 + square root of 5)/2), a rhombus made of two equilateral triangles (square root of 3), an equilateral triangle with its centre (square root of 3), and an equilateral triangle with a fourth point on its axis at side-length distance from the apex, beyond the apex and beyond the base (square root of (2 + square root of 3) for both).

difficulty_rationale: Requires classifying all four-point two-distance sets through a Ramsey-type graph case split and coordinate computations for each case.
